english.title: Helicopter operator fail to use CAA procedures to operate vibration health monitoring system
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of a helicopter, namely **(..SPECIFY HELICOPTER..), on which a vibration health monitoring system was required to be carried by paragraph 4(12) of Part 1 of Schedule 6 to the Air Navigation Order 2016, failed to operate that equipment in accordance with procedures approved by the CAA in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 119(8) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016
